data.name: Cabina.Ft710.ABAyuda
data.value: A/B — Changes the operating VFO, like the key on the rig (SV;, which on the FT-710 toggles VS0/VS1 without touching the frequencies). Right-click: A=B, copies the active VFO onto the other (asks for confirmation).

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.BandAyuda
data.value: BAND — Next band (BU0;), using the rig's band stack: returns to the frequency and mode it had there. Right-click: previous band (BD0;).

data.value: CLAR — Click: receive clarifier (CF000). Mouse wheel over it: offset ±10 Hz per notch (CF001). Right-click: offset to zero. RT/XT/RC do not exist on the FT-710; the right command is CF.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.DialAyuda
data.value: Main dial. Mouse wheel (or arrow keys): each notch is ten steps of the rig's dial (menu 03-05-01/02: 20 Hz in SSB/CW); with FINE one step, with FAST a hundred. With LOCK it does not move.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.DspAyuda
data.value: What the centre of the knob (DSP) adjusts now. Click the knob: next; right-click: previous.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.DspResetAyuda
data.value: DSP RESET — There is no CAT command for this key: the program does the same by hand (IF shift to 0, default width for the mode, notch, contour and APF off).

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.FineFastAyuda
data.value: FINE/FAST — Each click: normal → FINE → FAST → normal (FN0/FN1/FN2). Amber with FINE or FAST. Changes the step of the drawn dial just like the rig's.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.FuncAyuda
data.value: What the FUNC knob adjusts now. Click the knob: next function; right-click: previous.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.LockAyuda
data.value: LOCK — Short press: locks the dial. Long press (1 s): turns the radio on or off (turning off asks for confirmation).

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.LockNombre
data.value: Dial lock (LOCK); long press, power on or off

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.MaVAyuda
data.value: M▶V — Copies the selected memory to VFO A (MA;). Overwrites whatever VFO A holds.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.NarAyuda
data.value: NAR — Narrow filter (NA01/NA00). The narrow width is the one set in each mode's NAR WIDTH menu.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.PilotoAyuda
data.value: Power indicator: blue when the rig is connected

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.QmbAyuda
data.value: QMB — Click: recalls the quick memory (QR;). Right-click = hold: stores the frequency in the quick memory (QI;), asks for confirmation because it pushes the rig's QMB stack.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.TuneAyuda
data.value: TUNE — Click: puts the tuner in line or bypasses it (does not transmit). Right-click = hold TUNE: tunes (AC003), TRANSMITS A CARRIER; asks for confirmation and goes through the PTT watchdog, cut off after 10 s.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.TuneDescripcion
data.value: Click: tuner in line or bypassed (AC001/AC000), does not transmit. Right-click: tune (AC003), transmits a carrier within a watched transmission of at most 10 s.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.VMAyuda
data.value: V/M — Toggles between the VFO and the memories (VM;). Amber while in memory mode; STEP/MCH then changes channel.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.VoxAyuda
data.value: VOX MOX — Click: VOX on/off. Right-click = MOX: TRANSMITS (asks for confirmation, goes through the PTT watchdog); another right-click releases it. The MOX label turns red while transmitting.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.VoxDescripcion
data.value: Click: VOX (VX1/VX0). Right-click: MOX, keys the rig through the PTT watchdog; another right-click releases it.

data.name: Cabina.Ft710.ZinAyuda
data.value: ZIN/SPOT — Click: ZIN, zero-in on the signal (ZI0; only does something in CW with a signal in the passband). Right-click: SPOT, reference tone (CS1/CS0).

data.value: {0} — {1}. This rig does not offer it over CAT.
